name: Reya's Sorrow
source:
Reya's Sorrow, which in the Ukrainian locale is called "Reya's Adventures in Wonderland", is a game about a witch girl and her quirky friend named Seeper. They have been through a lot together. And it's up to the player to decide how their adventure ends.

[translated from [url=https://samiiart.itch.io/reyas-sorrow]itch.io[/url]]
